feeds.title: The Verge » Netflix
feeds.description: With nearly 150 million subscribers around the world, Netflix has a commanding lead in the streaming wars. But it's also facing heavy competition from deep-pocketed conglomerates like Disney, Apple, and AT&T, and an ongoing wave of narrow, targeted streaming sites like CBS All Access and DC Universe, which can draw on popular existing franchises for original content. As fewer companies are willing to license out their films and shows to other streaming sites, Netflix is pouring billions of dollars annually into its own original content...
